title: Regularity of strict henselization divisor quotient
statement: Let R be a commutative regular ring and f in R such that R/(f) is regular. Let Ω be an algebraically closed field and barY : Spec Ω → Spec R a geometric point. Let b : R → strictHenselizationRing barY induce the canonical strict henselization structural morphism on spectra. If b(f) is not a unit, then strictHenselizationRing barY/(b(f)) is regular.

proof.text: Identify the affine pointed-neighbourhood colimit with the ring strict henselization of R at the prime p selected by barY, compatibly with b using hb and full faithfulness of Spec. Since the resulting map from R_p is local and b(f) is a nonunit, f lies in p. The localized quotient (R/(f))_(p/(f)) is regular local, because R/(f) is regular. Tag 05WS identifies its strict henselization with the quotient by b(f). Apply preservation of regularity (06LN); regular local implies regular.
